info.bio:
Christina Aguilera (Staten Island, Nueva York; 18 de diciembre de 1980) es una cantante, compositora, productora y ocasionalmente  actriz estadounidense de origen ecuatoriano e irlandés. Aguilera ha ganado numerosos premios, entre ellos cinco premios Grammy y un premio Grammy Latino. Christina Aguilera ha vendido mas de 130 millones de discos y sencillos en el mundo.

En 1999 estrenó su álbum debut Christina Aguilera. Al año siguiente lanzó una versión en español de algunas canciones del álbum

podcast.title: Ruling the Charts (1998-1999)
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera is cited as a prominent example of "teen pop by White Axe" that was "ruling the charts in 1998 and 1999." "Of course, teen pop by White Axe was also ruling the charts in 1998 and 1999, including Britney Spears, and Christina Aguilera."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: 1999 Singles Chart Dominance
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera (referred to as "Christina Aguilar") was among the artists who dominated the singles charts in 1999, marking her emergence as a major pop star. "Meanwhile, the singles charts were dominated by Cher, TLC, Christina Aguilar, Ricky Martin, Art Kelly, and Destiny's Child."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 00's Part 1: The Sad State of Rock

podcast.title: Album Rushed to Market
podcast.body: Caught in the rapid market shift after Britney Spears' January 1999 album release, Christina Aguilera was reportedly rushed into a recording studio within two months to record her own album, which was then on the market within three months. "a Cristina Glega la coge en correnada. Me tengo un estudio de grabación en dos meses y graba el disco entre meses, están en el mercado."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Debut Coincided with Britney Spears
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera released her debut album in 1999, the same year as Britney Spears, often leading to a perceived duality, though Britney Spears is noted as having been the first to launch. "Cristina Guilera sacaron el disco en mi vida... sacaron el disco en el 99."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Guantanamo Bay Torture
podcast.body: Tracks by Christina Aguilera were included in the unofficial torture playlist at Camp Delta, the military prison at Guantanamo Bay in Cuba. Interrogators selected music that was either readily available or simply amused them for "enhanced interrogation." "The torture playlist there also included March of the Pigs from 9-Inch Nails. We are the champions from Queen, Springsteens born in the USA, Angel of Death from Slayer, Metallica's won, and tracks from Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Playing a Role in the Music Market
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera is mentioned as an example of an artist that, along with others like Pink Floyd, plays its specific role in the music market and caters to its own audience. "de Pin Floyd, a Cristina Gledad, todos en el mercado musical juegan su terreno, juegan su papel y juegan para su público."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan
srcs.episode: Poniendo a Britney Spears en su lugar

podcast.title: Pop Music Decline
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera was a prominent figure in the pop music scene of the mid-90s, whose fans later transitioned to seeking more aggressive music as they matured and their musical tastes evolved. "But during that time, we were seeing the end of the spike in pop music, you know, the back street boys and instincts and Christine Aguilar is in Britney Spears and that group of people who had been into pop since the middle 90s with spice girls and whatever, they were now getting older and they were getting angry and they were looking for something that spoke to that anger and their fears and their frustrations."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alexisonfire - In Their Own Words Podcast

podcast.title: Songs Written by Sam Indicott
podcast.body: Christina Aguilera had songs written for her by Sam Indicott, the singer of The Bravery. "singer Sam Indicott has gone on to write songs for Christina Aguilera."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alt Rock Revivals Part 5: New Wave

podcast.title: Transition to Solo Career
podcast.body: Following her time on Disney Channel, Christina Aguilera, like Britney Spears, sought to establish a solo career in a music landscape dominated by boy and girl bands. "hasta Cristina Guilera varias intentaron lanzar sus carreras en solitario, pero era la generación de las Boys y las Yels Bans."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan

xref.title: Pop Music Shift
xref.body: The rise of Alexis on Fire and similar aggressive bands coincided with a shift in pop music in the mid-2000s. Fans who had grown up with pop acts like Backstreet Boys, N'Sync, Christina Aguilera, and Britney Spears from the mid-90s were aging and seeking music that expressed anger, fears, and frustrations, creating an opening for bands like Alexis on Fire and Billy Talent. "But during that time, we were seeing the end of the spike in pop music, you know, the back street boys and instincts and Christine Aguilar is in Britney Spears and that group of people who had been into pop since the middle 90s with spice girls and whatever, they were now getting older and they were getting angry and they were looking for something that spoke to that anger and their fears and their frustrations."
